images.author: CDC / B.G. Partin; Dr. Erskine Palmer
images.why: Verified grayscale fallback: caption identifies a single varicella-zoster virus (HHV-3) in a TEM. Prominent isolated particle suits a near-square crop. Linked JPEG is low-resolution; source offers a 3.04 MB original, but its direct download could not be verified. Does not meet the strong-colour requirement.

images.author: CDC / Dr. Erskine Palmer
images.why: Verified grayscale fallback: caption identifies VZV virions from vesicle fluid collected from a chickenpox patient. Multiple particles provide crop flexibility. Linked JPEG is low-resolution; source offers a 1.7 MB original, but its direct download could not be verified. No qualifying colour candidate was verified; the NIH Flickr image titled Varicella-zoster was excluded because its caption identifies herpes simplex.
